scope: The Bayraktar Mosque in Nicosia as photographed in April 1999, including the mapped prayer hall and entry wing, cream walls and buttresses, orange tile roofs, and the minaret and its corbelled balcony.

originalReview.notes: The 1999 street-side view shows a cream rectangular hall, shallow orange tile roof, arched side entry, and a stone minaret with a corbelled balcony and dark conical cap.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact published Qualla original matches the only Commons file upload. Bayreuth2009 is the named photographer and original uploader and applied an explicit own-work CC0 dedication.
